book.name: Marcos
book.title: To Madojow no Nawnangonon no Sinuyat ni Marcos

content: To mgo Tumanon to mgo Pariseo
Na, mey naman-andiya ki Jesus no mgo Pariseo dow mgo maistru to tinuuhan no napuun diya to Jerusalem.
Napaniidan dan to duma no mgo inanad ni Jesus no migkoon no wada panghugas to boyad.
Su to mgo Hibru, yabi to mgo Pariseo, kona ogkoon ko kona makapanghugas to mgo boyad to paagi no ing-anad to mgo minuna dan.

Hasta ko ogkapuun sikandan diya to merkadu, ogpanghugas su iyan tumanon dan ayha ogkoon. Aw mahan-in pad to nabatasan dan no ogtumanon angod pananglit to paghugas to mgo tasa, mgo tibud, dow mgo son-adan.

Tongod to sikan, pig-usip si Jesus to sikan mgo Pariseo dow mgo maistru to tinuuhan, “Nokoy no kona man ogtuman to mgo inanad nu to mgo tumanon no nabuyatan ta? Su ogkoon sikandan no kona ogpanghugas to mgo boyad.”
Pigtabak sikandan ni Jesus, “Kunungkun mangkatarong! Tinood yagboy to diya kagi to Diyus no sinuyat ni Isaias no kibali ba-ba din bahin iyu no pig-iling din,

content.text: ‘Seini no mgo otow og-iling to pigtahud a dan,
di kotob da to tumuy to dila dan
su wada a ibotang duon to ginhawa dan.
Wada pues to pagsimba dan kanay,
su iyan da igpang-anad dan to tumanon no pig-otawan.’

content: Kagi ni Jesus, “Pig-ojowan now to mgo sugu to Diyus aw ilisi to tumanon no pig-otawan.
“Mapandoy gajod to pagkasalikway now to kasuguan to Diyus agun iyan nasi matuman to iyu no tumanon.
Angod pananglit to diya sugu to Diyus no impabaja ki Moises no pig-iling, ‘Tahuda to amoy dow inoy nu.’
Insugu din isab no inggad hintawa no ogpasipaya to ginikanan oghimatajan.
Di sikiyu, yahi to ing-anad now. Su inggad meyduon podom igkatabang to otow to ginikanan din, ogpabalibadon now sikandan to pag-iling, ‘Meyduon podom bobogoy ku iyu di impaabin kud nasi to Diyus.’
Duon to sikan, napogongan now on sikandin to pagtabang to ginikanan din,
aw pinakawada now to kagi to Diyus tongod to sikan kabilin now no tumanon. Mahan-in pad isab to duma no oghinangon now no angod to sikan.”
Pighimun isab ni Jesus to kaotawan aw ikagihi, “Paminog kow tibo to seini og-ikagihon ku aw panginsabuti now.
Inggad nokoy no ogkoonon to otow kona no iyan ogpakaligsom kandin. Iyan da ogpakaligsom sikan ogkapuun duon to ginhawa din.”
No likatan on ni Jesus to kaotawan aw makased on duon to bayoy, nangusip to mgo inanad dow nokoy to igpasabut to diya pig-ikagi din.
Kagi ni Jesus, “Sikiyu isab, wada kow naan makasabut? To ogkoonon to otow kona no iyan ogpakaligsom kandin.
Su diya da ogdeg to gotok, aw tapus to sikan ogyuwas da to yawa din. Kona sikan ogpakaandiya to ginhawa din.” Duon to sikan, impasabut ni Jesus no wadad pagkoon no ing-ojow to Diyus.
Migpadajun si Jesus to pag-ikagi, “Iyan nasi ogpakaligsom to otow sikan ogkapuun duon to ginhawa din.
Su duon ogkapuun to madoot no mgo hona-hona, paghinang to kayaw-ajan, pagpangawat, paghimatoy,
pagkahakog, pagkayawan-on, paglimbung, pagpatujang, pagsilag, pagbuung to dongog to duma, pagpagarbu dow pagpabuang-buang.
Seini mangkadoot no hinang duon ogkapuun to ginhawa to otow, aw iyan ogpakaligsom kandin.”
To Pagtuu to Bohi no Kona no Hibru
Dajun panow si Jesus aw andiya to banwa no sakup to siyudad to Tiro. Pagtidow din, duon sikandin paabut to songo bayoy. Gustu din no wada ogkamaan no duon on sikandin, di natagahan da.

Na, duon to sikan no banwa meyduon bohi no kona no Hibru. Diya sikandin i-anak to Fenicia no sakup to Siria, aw Grigu to inikagihan din. Meyduon anak din no bohi no pigsamuk to madoot no ispiritu. Na, pagkamaan to sikan bohi no duon on si Jesus, dajun sikandin mig-anduon aw yuhud duon to atubangan din aw pangamuju no abugon din sikan ispiritu.
Di kagi ni Jesus, “To mgo anak iyan una no ogpakoonon, su madoot ko agawon to koonon dan agun itimbag diya to mgo idu.”
“Iyan man iyan Sir,” kagi to sikan bohi, “di ngani man to idu di ogpakapanginamut to mgo timu no ogkatanak to mgo bata no ogpamangoon.”
“Na,” kagi ni Jesus, “uli kad on. Tongod to sikan kagi nu, pigyagujan on to madoot no ispiritu sikan anak nu.”
Dajun uli sikan bohi. Pagtidow din diya to bayoy, pigkita din sikan anak din no mighibat pad, di pigyagujan on iyan to madoot no ispiritu.
To Pagdojow to Otow no Bongey dow Poha
Pagpauli on ni Jesus likat to banwa no sakup to siyudad to Tiro, migbaja sikandin duon to Sidon aw duon to danow to Galilea padeg diya to banwa to Decapolis.
Na, meyduon mgo otow no migdae duon ki Jesus to otow no bongey dow poha aw hangyu no dampaon din.

Impadiyu ni Jesus sikan bongey to sikan mgo otow no nahimun aw yugyuga to tudyu din to mgo talinga to sikan bongey. Tapus to sikan, pigdopuhan ni Jesus to tudyu din to yawoy aw tudi-a to dila to sikan otow.
Dajun yanghag si Jesus diya to yangit aw ginhawa to mahaba aw ikagihi sikan otow, “Maabri kow.”
Duon-dajun migdinog sikan otow aw matul-id on to pag-ikagi din.
Pigbahog ni Jesus sikan mgo otow no wada ognangonan dan to sikan pighinang din, di nasi sikandan naosoyan
to pagnawnangon.
Yagboy natingaya to tibo aw nakaikagi, “Aduy! Madojow to tibo mgo hinang to sikan otow. Inggad to bongey ogpadinogon din, aw to poha ogpaikagihon.”

footnotes.text: Bersikulu 16 ogkakitaan duon to duma no mgo sinuyat no Ginirigu. Pig-iling: Na, sikiyu no ogpakadinog to seini, ibotang yagboy duon to ginhawa now.
